ask: select Elena Quintero at Grayson Robotics, and nobody else
why: THE RECORDED FAILURE, and the reason this package exists. In the first version of this demo the only selection verb was `select-where(company, status?)`, so the honest answer to this ask was all 410 people at her employer — and a real model correctly refused rather than do that. The verb list was wrong and the model was right, and nothing in the repository would have caught it. `select-contact` is the fix; `forbid` is what keeps it fixed.
